Microagi claims a $100 million annualized revenue run rate

The CEO reports the milestone six months after Shift launched; the breakdown remains undisclosed.

Humanoids Daily ↗9 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1Videos 1

The business claim

CEO Bercan Kilic announced the figure on October 9, measuring from Shift’s launch. Shift collects human-activity data for robot training; the announcement gives no robot delivery count.

Understanding the metric

Although the graphic says ARR, its footnote defines an annualized run rate. This extrapolates a revenue pace rather than confirming $100 million earned over six months.

What remains unknown

The announcement does not separate data revenue from Atlas robotics activities or recurring contracts. The claim remains independently unverified and does not establish progress toward robot deployment targets.
